facets.description: Office365 createEvent (office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts lines 73-76) always uses the first destination calendar instead of the one matching the current credentialId, so secondary collective hosts target the organizer's calendar
Lark CalendarService has the same first-element destinationCalendar selection problem
Base CalendarService (packages/lib/CalendarService.ts) has the same first-element destinationCalendar selection problem
